gate.note: Passing this replay allows a separate shadow implementation. It does not authorize a live Season Worker replacement.

method.role: Target-season preseason depth chart when available; otherwise target roster plus prior-role continuity. Low-confidence roles remain generic.
method.rate: Player Identity rate is blended only for stable starter/co-starter continuities. Backups, developmental players, low samples, and role changes remain on the generic role baseline.
method.availability: Historical game availability remains separate from rate and is applied only to identity-eligible stable starters.
method.contract: Contract context remains an optional flag from the baseline layer and never creates a blanket boost.
